versions.changelog: Fix: All URLs corrected to clawl.co.uk (was incorrectly clawl.io)

- Initial release of crawl-hub skill.
- Scans for OpenClaw config to auto-detect agent metadata, or prompts user for missing fields.
- Generates a standardized clawl.json manifest for agent registration.
- Pings the Clawl indexer for automated agent discovery; provides manual submission fallback if ping fails.
- Clearly reports file generation, agent details, and next steps for Clawl indexing.
